# Akan.js

> Akan.js is a Bun-first full-stack TypeScript framework for building web, app-oriented clients, servers, APIs, databases, and deployment surfaces from one consistent codebase.

Akan.js focuses on business code over framework wiring. It uses strict conventions, shared domain modules, type-safe services, generated clients, SQLite-first data paths, and a single Bun runtime from local development to production.

This file points LLMs to the current Akan.js website content. Legacy docs, demo-only routes, modal tests, and runtime inspection pages are intentionally omitted.

## Core Site

- [Home](https://akanjs.com/): product overview, installation, platform surfaces, automation examples, and positioning.
- [Blog](https://akanjs.com/blog): product notes, release notes, performance reports, and framework philosophy.

- [Quick Start](https://akanjs.com/docs/intro/quickstart): create and run a new Akan workspace.

- [Practice](https://akanjs.com/docs/intro/practice): guided hands-on introduction.

## Core Concepts

- [Akan Runtime](https://akanjs.com/docs/core/runtime): Bun runtime, environment variables, server execution, and deployment runtime behavior.
- [File Based Routing](https://akanjs.com/docs/core/routing): route generation from page files.
- [Multi Client](https://akanjs.com/docs/core/multi-client): web and app-oriented client surfaces.
- [App Config](https://akanjs.com/docs/core/config): `akan.config.ts` application configuration.
- [Folder Rule](https://akanjs.com/docs/core/folder-rule): allowed application and library folder structure.
- [File Rule](https://akanjs.com/docs/core/file-rule): naming and placement rules for Akan source files.
- [Data Layer](https://akanjs.com/docs/core/data-layer): schema, document, service, signal, and store data flow.

## Conventions

- [Workspace Structure](https://akanjs.com/conventions/workspace/structure): monorepo and workspace layout.

- [Components](https://akanjs.com/conventions/applib/ui): `ui/` component placement.
- [Server Utils](https://akanjs.com/conventions/applib/srvkit): `srvkit/` server utility placement.
- [Web Utils](https://akanjs.com/conventions/applib/webkit): `webkit/` browser utility placement.
- [Common Utils](https://akanjs.com/conventions/applib/common): shared `common/` utility placement.
- [App Config](https://akanjs.com/conventions/applib/config): application config conventions.
- [Domain Overview](https://akanjs.com/conventions/module/overview): domain module shape.
- [Domain Constants](https://akanjs.com/conventions/module/constant): `model.constant.ts`.
- [Domain Dictionary](https://akanjs.com/conventions/module/dictionary): `model.dictionary.ts`.
- [Domain Document](https://akanjs.com/conventions/module/document): `model.document.ts`.
- [Domain Service](https://akanjs.com/conventions/module/service): `model.service.ts`.
- [Domain Signal](https://akanjs.com/conventions/module/signal): `model.signal.ts`.
- [Domain Store](https://akanjs.com/conventions/module/store): `model.store.ts`.
- [Domain UI Files](https://akanjs.com/conventions/module/template): `Model.Template.tsx` and related domain UI files.
- [Scalar Overview](https://akanjs.com/conventions/scalar/overview): scalar module shape.
- [Service Overview](https://akanjs.com/conventions/service/overview): service module shape.
